newsitem.title: FINLAND: BIRKA LINE SEES CLEARLY HIGHER 1996 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: BIRKA LINE SEES CLEARLY HIGHER 1996 PROFIT.

text.p: Finnish shipping company Birka Line Ab said on Thursday it expected the group to show a clearly higer profit in 1996 than in 1995.
"For the whole group in total, the result is expected to be positive and significantly better than last year," it said in a statement with its January-August results.
In 1995, Birka posted a 3.6 million markka profit before extraordinary items, and including a 12.1 million markka extraordinuary gain, the net profit was 10.6 million.
Birka's 1996 January-August net result rose to a 45.8 million markka profit from a 2.9 million loss and it was boosted by a 28.4 million markka extraordinary gain.
This was the payment of a written-off receivable from the bankruptcy estate of ~Wartsila Marine~annnounced earlier.
